utilization_conditions.summary: 默认 Zipkin HTTP collector 匿名开放时，带 gzip 的小 wire-size / 大解压后 Zipkin v2 spans 请求可触发目标 JVM Java heap OOM；1GiB JVM heap、2GiB 容器复测中，160000 spans / 8192-byte tag 的约 3.37MiB gzip 请求导致容器 exit 3 和持续 /health 502。
limits_or_mitigations: Disable external exposure of the Zipkin HTTP collector for untrusted clients.
Reject or strictly bound gzip Content-Encoding, decompressed size, span count, per-request body size, and request rate before collector decoding.
Ingress or Armeria request-size limits may block larger plain requests, but this 1GiB retest shows gzip decompression can reach heap pressure before an effective decompressed-size rejection.
not_affected_when: HTTP collector is disabled or reachable only from trusted instrumentation clients.
Authentication, network ACLs, or gateway controls block anonymous POST /api/v2/spans.
A front proxy or application filter enforces decompressed-size, span-count, or gzip-ratio limits before Zipkin decodes spans.

config_changes: Container memory limited to 384m as validation containment.
Second run removed --rm from the copied start script only to preserve crash logs; application configuration was not changed.

trigger.request_shape: Anonymous POST /api/v2/spans with valid Zipkin v2 JSON span list; final failing request used gzip Content-Encoding under a 1GiB JVM heap.
trigger.loop_variable: span_count, uncompressed body bytes, gzip expansion ratio
trigger.bandwidth_notes: The 1GiB retest used about 3.37MiB on the wire and about 1.356GiB after gzip decompression; earlier plain requests returned HTTP 202 before the gzip expansion request failed.
